macros.name: markdownBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownBegin macro marks the beginning of a markdown document fragment and the \markdownEnd macro marks its end.

macros.name: markdownEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownBegin macro marks the beginning of a markdown document fragment and the \markdownEnd macro marks its end.

macros.name: markdownIfSnippetExists
macros.doc: To decide whether a snippet exists, we can use the \markdownIfSnippetExists macro.

macros.name: markdownInput
macros.doc: The \markdownInput macro accepts a single parameter with the filename of a markdown document and expands to the result of the conversion of the input markdown document to plain TeX.

macros.name: markdownRendererAcronym
macros.doc: \markdownRendererAcronym represents an acronym, initialism, or another all-caps sequence.

macros.name: markdownRendererAttributeKeyValue
macros.doc: \markdownRendererAttributeKeyValue represents an html attribute in the form xkeyy=xvaluey that is neither an identifier nor a class name.

macros.name: markdownRendererBlockQuoteBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererBlockQuoteBegin macro represents the beginning of a block quote.

macros.name: markdownRendererBlockQuoteEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererBlockQuoteEnd macro represents the end of a block quote.

macros.name: markdownRendererBracketedSpan
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererBracketedSpan macro represents an inline bracketed span.

macros.name: markdownRendererCite
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererCite macro represents a string of one or more parenthetical citations.

macros.name: markdownRendererCodeSpan
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererCodeSpan macro represents inline code span in the input text.

macros.name: markdownRendererContentBlockOnlineImage
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererContentBlockOnlineImage macro represents an iA Writer online image content block.

macros.name: markdownRendererDisplayMath
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInlineMath and \markdownRendererDisplayMath macros represent inline and display TeX math.

macros.name: markdownRendererDlBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlBegin macro represents the beginning of a definition list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererDlBeginTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlBeginTight macro represents the beginning of a definition list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererDlDefinitionBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlDefinitionBegin macro represents the beginning of a definition in a definition list.

macros.name: markdownRendererDlDefinitionEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlDefinitionEnd macro represents the end of a definition in a definition list.

macros.name: markdownRendererDlEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlEnd macro represents the end of a definition list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererDlEndTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlEndTight macro represents the end of a definition list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererDlItem
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlItem macro represents a term in a definition list.

macros.name: markdownRendererDlItemEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDlItemEnd macro represents the end of a list of definitions for a single term.

macros.name: markdownRendererDocumentBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDocumentBegin and \markdownRendererDocumentEnd macros represent the beginning and the end of a markdown document.

macros.name: markdownRendererDocumentEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererDocumentBegin and \markdownRendererDocumentEnd macros represent the beginning and the end of a markdown document.

macros.name: markdownRendererEllipsis
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererEllipsis macro replaces any occurrence of ascii ellipses in the input text.

macros.name: markdownRendererEmphasis
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererEmphasis macro represents an emphasized span of text.

macros.name: markdownRendererError
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererWarning and \markdownRendererError macros represent warnings and errors produced by the markdown parser.

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlBegin macro represents the beginning of a fancy ordered list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlBeginTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlBeginTight macro represents the beginning of a fancy ordered list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlEnd macro represents the end of a fancy ordered list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlEndTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlEndTight macro represents the end of a fancy ordered list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlItem
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlItem macro represents an item in a fancy ordered list.

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlItemEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlItemEnd macro represents the end of an item in a fancy ordered list.

macros.name: markdownRendererFancyOlItemWithNumber
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererFancyOlItemWithNumber macro represents an item in a fancy ordered list.

macros.name: markdownRendererHardLineBreak
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHardLineBreak macro represents a hard line break.

macros.name: markdownRendererHeadingFive
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHeadingFive macro represents a fifth level heading.

macros.name: markdownRendererHeadingFour
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHeadingFour macro represents a fourth level heading.

macros.name: markdownRendererHeadingOne
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHeadingOne macro represents a first level heading.

macros.name: markdownRendererHeadingSix
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHeadingSix macro represents a sixth level heading.

macros.name: markdownRendererHeadingThree
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHeadingThree macro represents a third level heading.

macros.name: markdownRendererHeadingTwo
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererHeadingTwo macro represents a second level heading.

macros.name: markdownRendererImage
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererImage macro represents an image.

macros.name: markdownRendererInlineHtmlComment
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInlineHtmlComment macro represents the contents of an inline html comment.

macros.name: markdownRendererInlineHtmlTag
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInlineHtmlTag macro represents an opening, closing, or empty inline html tag.

macros.name: markdownRendererInlineMath
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInlineMath and \markdownRendererDisplayMath macros represent inline and display TeX math.

macros.name: markdownRendererInputBlockHtmlElement
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInputBlockHtmlElement macro represents a block html element.

macros.name: markdownRendererInputFencedCode
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInputFencedCode macro represents a fenced code block.

macros.name: markdownRendererInputRawBlock
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInputRawBlock macro represents a raw block.

macros.name: markdownRendererInputRawInline
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInputRawInline macro represents an inline raw span.

macros.name: markdownRendererInputVerbatim
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInputVerbatim macro represents a code block.

macros.name: markdownRendererInterblockSeparator
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererInterblockSeparator macro represents an interblock separator between two markdown block elements.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataBegin macro represents the beginning of a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataBoolean
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataBoolean macro represents a boolean scalar value in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataEmpty
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataEmpty macro represents an empty scalar value in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataEnd macro represents the end of a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataMappingBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataMappingBegin macro represents the beginning of a mapping in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataMappingEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataMappingEnd macro represents the end of a mapping in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataNumber
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataNumber macro represents a numeric scalar value in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataSequenceBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataSequenceBegin macro represents the beginning of a sequence in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererJekyllDataSequenceEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererJekyllDataSequenceEnd macro represents the end of a sequence in a yaml document.

macros.name: markdownRendererLineBlockBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererLineBlockBegin and \markdownRendererLineBlockEnd macros represent the beginning and the end of a line block.

macros.name: markdownRendererLineBlockEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererLineBlockBegin and \markdownRendererLineBlockEnd macros represent the beginning and the end of a line block.

macros.name: markdownRendererLink
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererLink macro represents a hyperlink.

macros.name: markdownRendererMark
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererMark macro represents a span of marked or highlighted text.

macros.name: markdownRendererNbsp
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererNbsp macro represents a non-breaking space.

macros.name: markdownRendererNote
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererNote macro represents a note.

macros.name: markdownRendererOlBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlBegin macro represents the beginning of an ordered list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererOlBeginTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlBeginTight macro represents the beginning of an ordered list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererOlEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlEnd macro represents the end of an ordered list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererOlEndTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlEndTight macro represents the end of an ordered list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererOlItem
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlItem macro represents an item in an ordered list.

macros.name: markdownRendererOlItemEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlItemEnd macro represents the end of an item in an ordered list.

macros.name: markdownRendererOlItemWithNumber
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererOlItemWithNumber macro represents an item in an ordered list.

macros.name: markdownRendererParagraphSeparator
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererParagraphSeparator macro represents a paragraph separator.

macros.name: markdownRendererReplacementCharacter
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererReplacementCharacter macro represents the U+0000 and U+FFFD Unicode characters.

macros.name: markdownRendererSectionBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererSectionBegin and \markdownRendererSectionEnd macros represent the beginning and the end of a section based on headings.

macros.name: markdownRendererSectionEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererSectionBegin and \markdownRendererSectionEnd macros represent the beginning and the end of a section based on headings.

macros.name: markdownRendererSoftLineBreak
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererSoftLineBreak macro represents a soft line break.

macros.name: markdownRendererStrikeThrough
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererStrikeThrough macro represents a strike-through span of text.

macros.name: markdownRendererStrongEmphasis
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererStrongEmphasis macro represents a strongly emphasized span of text.

macros.name: markdownRendererSubscript
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererSubscript macro represents a subscript span of text.

macros.name: markdownRendererSuperscript
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererSuperscript macro represents a superscript span of text.

macros.name: markdownRendererTable
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererTable macro represents a table.

macros.name: markdownRendererTextCite
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererTextCite macro represents a string of one or more text citations.

macros.name: markdownRendererThematicBreak
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererThematicBreak macro represents a thematic break.

macros.name: markdownRendererUlBegin
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererUlBegin macro represents the beginning of a bulleted list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererUlBeginTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererUlBeginTight macro represents the beginning of a bulleted list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererUlEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererUlEnd macro represents the end of a bulleted list that contains an item with several paragraphs of text (the list is not tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererUlEndTight
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererUlEndTight macro represents the end of a bulleted list that contains no item with several paragraphs of text (the list is tight).

macros.name: markdownRendererUlItem
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererUlItem macro represents an item in a bulleted list.

macros.name: markdownRendererUlItemEnd
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererUlItemEnd macro represents the end of an item in a bulleted list.

macros.name: markdownRendererWarning
macros.doc: The \markdownRendererWarning and \markdownRendererError macros represent warnings and errors produced by the markdown parser.

macros.name: markdownSetupSnippet
macros.doc: We may set up options as snippets using the \markdownSetupSnippet macro and invoke them later.

macros.name: markinline
macros.doc: The \markinline macro accepts a single mandatory parameter containing inline markdown content and expands to the result of the conversion of the input markdown document to plain TeX.

macros.name: yamlBegin
macros.doc: The \yamlBegin macro marks the beginning of an yaml document fragment and the \yamlEnd macro marks its end.

macros.name: yamlEnd
macros.doc: The \yamlBegin macro marks the beginning of an yaml document fragment and the \yamlEnd macro marks its end.

macros.name: yamlInput
macros.doc: The \yamlInput macro accepts a single parameter with the filename of a yaml document and expands to the result of the conversion of the input yaml document to plain TeX.
